title: Configuring Your Zoho MCP Server
snippet:
To configure your Zoho MCP server:
1. Navigate to the **Zoho MCP console**. ([mcp.zoho.com](https://mcp.zoho.com/mcp-client#))
2. Provide a name for your Zoho MCP server and click **Create Server**.
![Naming Zoho MCP server](https://www.zohowebstatic.com/sites/zweb/images/cliq/naming-a-mcp-server.png)
3. The Zoho MCP Server will be created. Click the **Configure Tools** button to configure the required tools
4. Choose **Zoho Cliq**.
![Zoho Cliq tool in Zoho MCP Server](https://www.zohowebstatic.com/sites/zweb/images/cliq/zoho-cliq-in-mcp-product-list.png)
5. You will be presented with a list of tools. These tools provide the appropriate context and access to perform the required actions instructed in the prompt. You can also search for your required tools using the search-bar.
![Choose list of tools from Zoho Cliq](https://www.zohowebstatic.com/sites/zweb/images/cliq/images/choose_cliq_tools.gif)
6. Click **Add Now**, once you have selected the required tools.
7. All the required tools will be added to your Zoho MCP server.

A unique and secure URL will be generated by the Zoho MCP service each time you create a Zoho MCP server. This MCP URL will serve as the endpoint invoked when a prompt is executed from your MCP Client.
![Setting up MCP URL](https://www.zohowebstatic.com/sites/zweb/images/cliq/mcp-url.png)
To copy the MCP URL:
1. Click the **Connect** tab in the sidebar.
2. Click the copy button next to the URL to copy it.
Now you can use this URL to integrate your Zoho MCP server with your MCP Client. Additionally, you can also click the **API Key Re-Generate** button to generate a new MCP URL endpoint to invoke your Zoho MCP server.

title: Bring AI into your workflow with Zoho Cliq’s Model Context Protocol (MCP)
snippet:
With Zoho Cliq's Model Context Protocol (MCP), AI in Cliq goes beyond conversation by letting your AI agent take action across Cliq, Zoho apps and beyond, not just chat.
MCP is a standardized bridge between AI agents (like Claude, Windsurf, VS Code) and Cliq, layered on top of your data, apps, and actions - so you can say what you need in plain language, and watch it happen instantly

The Cliq MCP Server exposes Cliq's core capabilities as standardized tools, so MCP-compatible AI clients can read context, take action, and coordinate work across Zoho and third-party systems.

Tools
### Understand what's happening
AI reads your workspace, not just messages.
Cliq MCP gives AI access to channels, threads, users, roles, and past conversations — so it understands context, ownership, and decisions.
### Coordinate teams in real time
AI can organize people, not just data.
Create channels, route updates, notify the right teams, and respect org structure automatically.
### Monitor and surface what matters
Important signals reach you before you look for them.
AI monitors connected systems and brings critical updates into Cliq, where teams already work
### Retrieve context instantly
Ask once. Get the exact answer.
Find messages, files, records, or past decisions across your workspace — without searching manually.
## Works with your AI environment
Zoho Cliq MCP is completely model-agnostic. It doesn't connect to or depend on any specific LLM.
Instead, it exposes a standardized interface that any AI agent, powered by any LLM, can call through an MCP client.
Whether you're using GPT, Claude, a fine-tuned model, or an open-source LLM, as long as your agent speaks the MCP protocol, it can securely access tools, actions, and data across your Zoho apps.

### The MCP way
- Natural language prompts.
- API-native, agent-driven workflows.
- Secure, auditable execution with permission controls
- Protocol remains stable even as tools evolve
- Tools discovered at runtime, no hard-coding
- Reusable agents across multiple contexts
- Multi-app execution via a single agent.
Built for security, compliance, and scale
## Enterprise-ready from day one
Zoho Cliq's MCP follows Zoho's enterprise-grade security protocols. All data access and agent actions are governed by strict access controls, encrypted data handling, and audit trails, ensuring safe, compliant execution.
### Authentication & Authorization
Agents operate under user-level permissions and supports OAuth to ensure secure identity

title: Zoho Cliq MCP Tools
snippet:
# **Zoho Cliq MCP Tools**
The Zoho MCP server provides various tools for interacting with Zoho Cliq. The table below lists the available tools, along with their descriptions and everyday use cases.
## **Bots**
Bots
| Operation ID | Summary | Description |
|---|---|---|
| list_bots | List all bots | List all bots available to the authenticated user. |
| create_bot | Create a bot | Create a new bot in Cliq with a display name, description, and access level. |
| get_bot | Retrieve details of a specific bot | Retrieve the full configuration and details of a specific bot. |
| update_bot | Update an existing bot | Update an existing bot's display name, description, access level, or logo. |
| delete_bot | Delete a specific bot | Permanently delete a bot and all its handlers and configuration. |
| get_bot_handler | Get details of a specific bot handler | Retrieve the configuration and Deluge code of a specific bot handler. |
| create_bot_handler | Create a handler for a specific bot | Create a handler for a bot to define its behavior for a trigger event. |
| update_bot_handler | Update a handler for a specific bot | Update a bot handler's execution logic or configuration. |
| delete_bot_handler | Delete a handler from a specific bot | Permanently remove a handler from a bot. |
| list_bot_handler_executions | List execution records of a specific bot handler | List execution records for a specific bot handler within a time range. |
| trigger_bot_call | Trigger Bot Calls | Send a voice alert to specific users via a bot. |
| send_bot_webhook_message | Send an incoming webhook message to a bot | Post a message to a bot via its incoming webhook URL. |
| send_bot_message_v2 | Send a bot message | Send a message from a bot to specific users, a channel, or all subscribers. |
| list_bot_subscribers_v2 | List all subscribers of a specific bot | List subscribers of a specific bot with pagination support. |
---
## **Bulk Export**
Bulk Export
| Operation ID | Summary | Description |
|---|---|---|
| bulk_export_conversations | Export Conversations | Export details of all chats and group conversations in the organization. |
| bulk_export_channels | Export Channels | Export details of all channels in the organization. |
| bulk_export_chat_members | Export Members in a Conversation | Export member details from a specific chat or channel. |
| bulk_export_chat_messages | Export Messages | Export message transcripts or history of all conversations in the organization. |

# **Connecting Zoho Cliq MCP with Claude**
Link [Claude](https://claude.ai/) with Zoho MCP to facilitate real-world workflows in Zoho Cliq through a secure and simple setup within your conversation window.
#####
### **Setting up Zoho Cliq MCP in Claude**
Note: Only a Claude organization admin can complete these steps. Once connected, the integration is available to everyone in your Claude organization. However, only the admin can manage which tools are linked to the Zoho MCP instance.
1. Navigate to the bottom right corner of the Claude desktop and click on your profile.
2. Then, go to the **Settings**. Alternatively, you can open this link directly in your browser: [claude.ai/settings/connectors.](https://claude.ai/settings/connectors)
![Claude with Zoho Cliq MCP](//www.zohowebstatic.com/sites/zweb/images/cliq/claude-settings-1.jpg)
3. Click "**Connectors**" and select "**Add Custom Connecto**r" to create a new connector.
- In the Name field, enter a descriptive title for the connector (e.g., Zylker-Cliq-MCP).
- Paste the MCP URL provided by your Zoho MCP setup.
![Adding custom connector with Zoh](//www.zohowebstatic.com/sites/zweb/images/cliq/images/adding_connector_-_claude.gif)
4. Click **Add**.
5. The MCP service will now be integrated into your MCP Client. Click **Connect** to authorize the connector.

6. You will be taken to an OAuth screen that details all required permissions. Click **Allow**.
![selectedImg](https://desk.zoho.in/galleryDocuments/edbsn9c61293dd1d07515dd56567a747de8bd4e7076b4d0917dc0aace4f81bbae285102264bb2f20b92b1052a8191cbe66782efb05e5e21c08c71cb35f8cf01e3e779?inline=true)
You will now be able to perform actions in your required services, as your MCP Client is now linked with the Zoho MCP server.

title: Guide to Zoho Cliq's MCP Server
snippet:
Model Context Protocol (MCP) is an open protocol that establishes the standardized way applications can interact with Large Language Models (LLMs). An MCP allows you to carry out your desired workflow on your preferred LLMs by providing the instructions to an AI model in the proper context.
With an MCP, you can instruct popular AI agents, or even custom AI agents, to interact with native or third-party applications and complete complex workflows with little to no human intervention.
### **Zoho Cliq MCP Server**
The Zoho Cliq MCP Server brings your chats into the world of AI using the Model Context Protocol (MCP). This open protocol defines how AI agents can connect to real-world tools and data sources in a structured, predictable way.
The following diagram will provide you with an overview of what Zoho MCP will allow your AI agents to achieve:

Any AI model or agent can use our official MCP server to access your Cliq data and do:
- **More work, less chat**: Send quick messages to colleagues or groups with prompts like, "Post a product launch announcement in the #marketing-updates channel" or "Schedule a message about the agenda of the competitor campaign to the brand strategy group chat."
- **Never miss a beat**: Set reminders for yourself or others, such as "Alert the product team to test the beta by Wednesday" or "Cue the sales lead for the client pitch tomorrow," and adjust or reassign them as needed when work shifts.
- **Organize your chats**: Create channels on the fly for new projects, archive old ones like "Last Year's Audit" to stay current, and moderate your channels by deleting messages, viewing participants, or updating details.
- **Have focused discussions**: Start targeted threads like "Q4 Strategy 2026" and invite others to join or auto-follow all threads in a channel effortlessly.

title: Zoho Cliq MCP Server: connect your AI Agents to Zoho Cliq
Connecting Zoho Cliq MCP with VS Code
snippet:
# **Connecting Zoho Cliq MCP with VS Code**
Utilize tools directly within Visual Studio Code by integrating Zoho MCP. With Zoho MCP connected to Visual Studio Code, you can use Zoho Cliq tools without leaving your coding workspace.
This means you can send updates, check channel activity, or message teammates directly from VS Code, which is perfect for developers who want to keep the team in sync without context switching.
Note: For Zoho MCP to function correctly, ensure that **GitHub Copilot** is enabled and set to **Agent** mode****in Visual Studio Code. Also, ensure that the installed version of Visual Studio Code is version 1.101 or above.
##### Configuring Zoho MCP in Visual Studio Code
1. Open the **Command Palette** in Visual Studio Code (⇧ + ⌘ + P on Mac, Ctrl + Shift + P on Windows).
![](//www.zohowebstatic.com/sites/zweb/images/cliq/command-pallete-vs-code.png)
2. Type "**MCP: Add Server...**" and press **Enter**.
![](//www.zohowebstatic.com/sites/zweb/images/cliq/add-server-in-vc-code.png)
3. Choose"**HTTP****(HTTP or Server-Sent Events)** and press **Enter**.
![](//www.zohowebstatic.com/sites/zweb/images/cliq/http-events.png)
4. Paste your MCP **key** into the "Server Key" field and press **Enter**.
![](//www.zohowebstatic.com/sites/zweb/images/cliq/mcp-key.png)
5. Provide a name for the server and press **Enter**.
![](//www.zohowebstatic.com/sites/zweb/images/cliq/mcp-server-name-vscode.png)
6. Confirm that **GitHub Copilot** is set to **Agent** mode.
![](//www.zohowebstatic.com/sites/zweb/images/cliq/github-copilot-agent-mode.png)
**Caution**: Treat your MCP server key like a password! It can activate tools connected to your server and access sensitive data.
##### Accessing Zoho MCP Tools in VS Code
1. Open GitHub Copilot Chat in VS Code (bottom panel, or Ctrl+Shift+I / ⇧⌘I on Mac).
2. Ask GitHub Copilot to use **Zoho Cliq tools** from your Zoho MCP server.
3. Run real-world workflows directly from your editor, such as posting build updates, alerting teammates after commits, or checking channel activity, without switching out of VS Code.

title: Setting up the Zoho Cliq MCP Server
snippet:
# Setting up the Zoho Cliq MCP Server
You can integrate Zoho MCP (Model Context Protocol) and Cliq to trigger workflows and sync data across services with the help of popular AI agents.
You can follow the steps below to integrate Zoho MCP and Cliq:
1. Click on your profile image on the top-right corner.
2. Select **Bots & Tools**.
![](https://desk.zoho.in/galleryDocuments/edbsn70e522deea52ab74d440ee2a04c0c3d096830db8f9507fdcc6e32f95c692401f1dccb60c440431fb925bd479d73fad681746c9372756729c835448828eb24d9c?inline=true)
1. Go to **Cliq MCP** in the **Integrations** window and select **Set Up MCP Server**.
![](https://desk.zoho.in/galleryDocuments/edbsn70e522deea52ab74d440ee2a04c0c3d01e99db217ffaf04deaf12315d5c62774ab885c010243849ae7cc8b7888d787a8da88d5ecd5aeb924bc4a246582cd8bbc?inline=true)
1. Enter a server name and click on **Create server**.
![](https://desk.zoho.in/galleryDocuments/edbsn70e522deea52ab74d440ee2a04c0c3d0511f5ac795fe170df7b69dcacd528db7a4dc2f201cb64182e8dcebb74021f96448ec89f1d9132c44fe84286b01cdd79c?inline=true)

1. Once you create the server, you will have three options- **Tools**, **Connect** and **Connection**.

You can now add various tools and connect the available AI agents to your MCP Server. You can check out this [Guide to Zoho Cliq's MCP Server](https://www.zoho.com/cliq/help/platform/zoho-cliq-mcp.html) to know how to connect and configure various tools with the AI agents.
